facts.claim: AIDAPerla (AIDA Cruises): Entered service 2017; 125,572 GT; 3290 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 300 m length; Hyperion class.
AIDAperla is a cruise ship of AIDA Cruises, which was built by Mitsubishi Shipbuilding at their shipyard in Nagasaki, Japan.

catalogSpecs.description: Twin sister to AIDAprima, featuring the covered Beach Club for year-round summer vibes and the Four Elements activity deck.
